justification: `android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/clipboard/ClipboardInterface.java` is the only class in this package and it imports only Android framework types (`android.content.*`, `android.util.Log`), with no dependencies on other in-repo packages. The only in-repo references I found are from `android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/CaptureActivity.java` and `android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/share/ShareActivity.java` (2 callers). That makes this package a small leaf utility, not one that depends on less-stable project packages.
